QuestInfo.name: I Like Pink Too
QuestInfo.0: After adventuring far and wide and encountering powerful enemies, you feel that you need to become much stronger than you are now to protect everyone. Ask Eskalade how much reputation is required to unlock the next power.
QuestInfo.1: After adventuring far and wide and encountering powerful enemies, you feel that you need to become much stronger than you are now to protect everyone. Ask Eskalade how much reputation is required to unlock the next power.
QuestInfo.2: Eskalade said you can still gain reputation without transforming into Angelic Buster. You were already prepared to receive the final power, but he confessed that he was afraid of not being able to see you as Angelic Buster anymore. You were disgusted that he didn't tell you when everything was prepared, but you don't mind transforming into Angelic Buster. Pink is good, and making others happy makes you happy.
